usedFor: Moskit is a CRM where “New Deal” and “New Contact” start steps and “Add Deal Note” records what happened.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Moskit, then “Add Content to Page” in Notion
bestTemplate.why: A new contact is saved as a page, so the details are kept outside the CRM too.

watchOut: “New Contact” is polling, so it runs on a scheduled check and a short delay is normal.
